title: Agy-router provider remap
scope: Business router provider mapping for the Feishu assistant after separating short acknowledgement chatter from the LLM path and retiring qwen3.6-flash from casual and ops_writing primary routes.
acceptance_criteria: The default provider config includes deepseek-v4-pro, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-8, grok-4.3, and the existing Gemini/Codex fallback providers.
Short acknowledgement chatter such as 嗯/哈哈/6/ok is handled locally without calling Agy or another LLM.
Casual, ops_writing, work-preflight, lightweight copy, realtime, and fallback route to cli/antigravity/gemini-3.5-flash with aihubmix/gemini-3.5-flash fallback.
qwen3.6-flash is not used as the primary route for casual or ops_writing.
Public opinion routes to cli/grok-build and falls back to aihubmix/grok-4.3.
Creative routes to aihubmix/deepseek-v4-pro, insight routes to aihubmix/claude-sonnet-4-6, deep_creative routes to aihubmix/claude-opus-4-7, and deep_insight routes to aihubmix/claude-opus-4-8.
Router tests and README document the same mapping.
